column1: # The grammar of the offset in a stack or bracketed parameter source, "esp-8" or
# "[esi+0x10]", as both parsers must read it.
# ParseSignedOffset in wrapper_base.h and TryParseSignedOffset in Parameter.cs are the same
# grammar in two languages, kept in step the way constant-sources.tsv keeps the constant
# grammar: a test on each side reads this file. An offset one parser reads differently from
# the other is a hook that validates and then reads the wrong slot.
# text<TAB>outcome<TAB>value   outcome is parsed or malformed; value only when parsed.
